It is the world's largest manufacturer of moulded furniture and Asia's largest processor of plastic moulded products.{{cite news|url=http://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/tp-features/tp-metroplus/store-food-safely/article3720115.ece |title=Store food safely |newspaper= [[The Hindu]] |access-date=5 May 2017}}{{cite book|last=Allan|first=Rory|title=Investment Policy Review: Nepal|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=hi0Ncw3ulf0C&dq=nilkamal+plastics&pg=PT56|access-date=7 July 2017|year=2003|publisher=United Nations Conference on Trade and Development|location=New York|isbn=9789211126198}} Their product range consists mainly of custom plastic mouldings, plastic furniture, crates and containers. The company also has a chain of retail stores under the @home brand.{{cite web|url=http://www.rediff.com/money/2005/oct/14nil.htm |title=Nilkamal group's latest venture |work= [[Rediff.com]] |access-date=5 May 2017}}{{cite news|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/improving-margins-may-earn-nilkamal-re-rating/articleshow/54775660.cms |title=Improving margins may earn Nilkamal re-rating |newspaper= [[The Economic Times]] |access-date=5 May 2017}}{{cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/brokers-call-nilkamal/article8650914.ece |title=Broker's Call: Nilkamal |newspaper= [[Business Line]] |access-date=5 May 2017}} ==History== Nilkamal was incorporated on 5 December 1985 as Creamer Plastic. The company changed its name to Nilkamal Plastic on 23 August 1990. In Year 2004 Company Changed Names to Nilkamal Ltd. The company has manufacturing facilities in [[Samba, Jammu|Samba]], [[Greater Noida]], [[Puducherry (city)|Pondicherry]], [[Barjora]], [[Sinnar]], [[Nashik]] and [[Silvassa]]. The company also has joint manufacturing ventures in Bangladesh (Nilkamal Padma Plastics) and Sri Lanka (Nilkamal Eswaran Plastics). In 2011, the company also began production of mattresses with manufacturing units in [[Hosur]] and [[Dankuni]].{{cite web|url=http://profit.ndtv.com/stock/nilkamal-ltd_nilkamal/reports |title=Nilkamal Ltd. |publisher= [[NDTV Profit]] |access-date=5 May 2017}}{{cite news|url=http://www.business-standard.com/company/nilkamal-ltd-2061/information/company-history |title=NILKAMAL LTD.
